pwa.installDescription: Add Kupito to your phone for faster access:
pwa.iosStep0: Open Safari browser on your iPhone or iPad and go to kupito.club
pwa.iosStep1: Tap the share button (square icon with arrow up) at the bottom of the screen
pwa.iosStep2: Among the options, select 'Add to Home Screen'
pwa.iosStep3: Confirm by tapping 'Add' in the top right corner. The app will appear on your home screen
pwa.androidStep0: Open Chrome browser on your Android phone and go to kupito.club
pwa.androidStep1: Tap the three dots icon (⋮) in the top right corner of the browser to open the menu
pwa.androidStep2: In the menu, select 'Add to Home Screen'
pwa.androidStep3: Confirm by tapping 'Add'. The app will appear on your home screen
pwa.browserNote: Note: Option names may differ in other browsers (Samsung Internet, Firefox, Edge, etc.)
pwa.offlineMessage: You are not connected to the internet. Check your connection.
